subject: Marketplace onboarding: metering, pricing, and contract questions
messages:
From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@globalretailco.com>

Cc: procurement@globalretailco.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Marketplace listing - metering, pricing, and billing flow clarifications

Hi Laura,

Thanks for submitting the marketplace intake materials. Our procurement team had a few follow-up questions to close out the technical/commercial review for GlobalRetailCo's vendor onboarding. Can you provide a short, consolidated response we can include in the RFP packet? Specifically: 

1) Metering dimensions and reporting: please list the exact metering dimension names and units you will publish for AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace (example: "InferenceToken/1k-tokens", "InstanceHours"). We need names that our billing ingestion can map to internal charge codes.

2) Pricing models by deployment type: what pricing dimensions map to Redwood's Hosted API vs Redwood Dedicated vs Private (on-prem)? For example, is Hosted always per-token, Dedicated per-instance-hour, and can Dedicated be metered by concurrent users?

3) Billing entity and invoice path: will GlobalRetailCo be billed through the cloud provider (AWS consolidated billing, Azure Cost Management) or directly by Redwood? Any required tax forms or marketplace seller account prerequisites?

4) Contract and redlines: do you accept our standard marketplace terms? We expect a redline to the MSA and a DocuSign link if possible. What are the typical timelines?

5) Security/compliance artefacts: confirmed SOC 2 type II date, data residency, and any PII handling notes. Attach the list of allowed artifacts if possible (we referenced the RFI template attached).

We attached our internal RFI_Template_GlobalRetailCo.xlsx to this thread for inline completion. Can you aim to return responses by EOD Wednesday (19 May) so procurement can finalize the vendor packet?

Appreciate it — happy to set a quick 30-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Michael Chen
Enterprise Procurement | GlobalRetailCo

Attachments: RFI_Template_GlobalRetailCo.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: GlobalRetailCo - marketplace metering / billing / timeline (answers)

Laura / Monica / Aditya — consolidated answers below (soups to nuts). I included implementation notes for each cloud marketplace; please review and flag anything legal needs to redline differently.

1) Metering dimensions (exact names we publish / report):
- AWS Marketplace (SaaS & AMI flows):
  - MeteringDimension: "Redwood.Inference.InferenceTokens" -> unit = tokens (we report in 1k token increments).
  - MeteringDimension: "Redwood.Inference.DedicatedInstanceHours" -> unit = hours (for Dedicated capacity SKUs).
  - MeteringDimension: "Redwood.Inference.EmbeddingUnits" -> unit = embedding-units (per 1k vectors).
- GCP Marketplace (Marketplace Metering API):
  - SKU_NAME: "redwood_inference_token_k" -> unit = 1k tokens.
  - SKU_NAME: "redwood_dedicated_hour" -> unit = hours.
- Azure Marketplace (Managed/Bring Your Own License flows):
  - MeteringId: "inference_tokens_k" -> unit = 1k tokens.
  - MeteringId: "dedicated_instance_hour" -> unit = hours.

Notes: we publish daily usage files to marketplace APIs and support billing ingestion via both cloud consolidated billing (AWS/Azure) and Seller-side invoicing (if required). Mapping table attached as 'marketplace-metering-spec.pdf'.

2) Pricing models by deployment:
- Hosted (Redwood API): primary pricing = per-token (pay-as-you-go), optional pre-purchased token bundles for volume discounts.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): pricing = base monthly reservation + usage surcharge measured as DedicatedInstanceHours when burst is used; can be converted to a pure hourly SKU for marketplaces (we publish DedicatedInstanceHours as the metered dimension).
- Private / On-prem: typically licensing fee + deployment support (quoted per-project). Marketplace listings usually only cover Hosted/Dedicated SaaS models.

3) Billing entity & invoice path:
- AWS: we support both AWS Marketplace Metering (charges flow via AWS billing to buyer) and ALSO direct invoicing (seller-billed) for enterprise deals where the buyer requests it. For AWS marketplace listings, payments generally route through AWS marketplace (buyer billed by AWS, payout to Redwood less AWS fees).
- GCP: similar marketplace metering flows; buyer will see charges on their GCP invoice.
- Azure: managed marketplace listings route through Azure; alternative direct-bill is available for enterprise agreements.

Requirements: buyer will need an active cloud marketplace account; in some cases we need a signed seller-buyer subscription document (DocuSign). Tax forms and W-9 / VAT ID collected during seller onboarding; we will provide guidance.

4) Contract & redlines:
- Monica: our standard approach is to accept limited redlines for MSA marketplace addenda. We maintain a 'master-seller-agreement-redlines.docx' with our common concessions. Typical turnaround: 2–5 business days for initial redline review.
- We can produce a DocuSign packet for the subscription + addendum; link (internal): https://docusign.com/link/GR-MSA-redlines.

5) Security & compliance artifacts:
- SOC 2 Type II: most recent audit period ended 2026-12-31 (we can provide a redacted SOC 2 summary).
- Data residency: Hosted API supports regional endpoints (us-east-1, eu-west-1); Dedicated can be provisioned in region.
- PII handling: Redwood does not persist input by default for Dedicated/Private; Hosted API has configurable retention policies and contractual terms available.

6) Operational notes & timeline:
- Marketplace listing + technical validation: ~2 weeks once we have billing contact and required seller forms.
- Procurement review & legal sign-off: dependent on buyer cadence; our experience is 1–3 weeks.
- Implementation items for GlobalRetailCo: provide billing contact, PO number (if direct invoicing), and preferred metering mapping.

Attachments included here for the external RFI: marketplace-metering-spec.pdf, SOC2-summary-redacted.pdf, master-seller-agreement-redlines.docx, rfi_response_matrix.xlsx.

Let me know if you want me on the Wednesday 19 May call — I can walk the procurement team through the metering table.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Marketplace Integrations | Redwood Inference
